'''2017 MPC Steve Brentson LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Brentson]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
